services.name: Program Guide
services.desc: Find City of Maple Ridge programs and activities for all ages, including arts, aquatics, sports, fitness, camps, youth, and more. Use this page to explore program guides, check registration information, and register online, by phone, or in person. The Maple Ridge Leisure Centre will have temporary closures on various facilities this summer and fall to allow for annual maintenance, deep cleaning and exciting new facility upgrades including the installation of new fitness centre equipment, spin studio expansion, sport court cleaning, and gymnasium floor refinishing. Our Program Guides are released four times per year, with available offerings varying by season and instructor availability.

services.name: ACT Venue Rental
services.desc: Ready to host a showstopper of your own? Whether a private gathering or public treat, the ACT Arts Centre has the right space for you! Starting January 1, 2026, the ACT Arts Centre will officially be operated by the City of Maple Ridge. We’re excited to begin this new chapter and look forward to continuing to serve our community with vibrant arts, culture, and event programming. If you're interested in renting space at the ACT Arts Centre, we welcome your inquiry! All rental requests will be received and responded to in the order they are submitted.
